meta.title: Industry Productivity & Pay Atlas — India core
meta.source: RBI India KLEMS database, release July 2024
meta.vintage_note: Single release used (no vintage splicing). The workbook Info sheet self-labels 'database 2023'; the file is the July 2024 release covering to 2022-23.

units.lp: '000 Rs per person employed, constant 2011-12 prices (real value added per person)
units.lsh_va: ratio: labour income / value added (broad labour income, incl. imputed self-employed labour)

definitions.labour_income: RBI KLEMS labour income = compensation of employees PLUS the labour part of self-employed mixed income (imputed via a Heckman-corrected Mincer wage equation). This is a BROAD labour-income measure, NOT ASI wages paid to formal workers.
definitions.lsh_times_lp: If shown, LSH_va x LP = labour income per worker in constant 2011-12 VALUE-ADDED prices; it is NOT a consumption-deflated wage.

meta.licence: Derived aggregate series from RBI India KLEMS, shown with attribution for research. Cite RBI India KLEMS (2024). The raw workbook is not redistributed here.
meta.descriptive_note: The within/composition split is an accounting identity, not a causal explanation.
